title: Church Account to Mercedes-Benz: A Pastor's Money Trail

lines.say: A hundred twenty-five thousand dollars from an investor, into a church bank account. Here is where it went, according to the government.
lines.show: $125,000 from an investor, into a church bank account. Here is where it went, according to the government.

lines.say: Thirteen thousand to the pastor's personal account, which had started the week overdrawn.
lines.show: $13,000 to the pastor's personal account, which had started the week overdrawn.
